build_CDiT_model: build a CDiT diffusion transformer model using CDiT_XL_2 or CDiT_L_2 config functions
create_TimestepEmbedder: create a TimestepEmbedder to embed scalar timesteps into sinusoidal vector representations
create_ActionEmbedder: create an ActionEmbedder to embed action x, y, and angle coordinates into vectors
run_CDiT_forward: run a forward pass of CDiT with spatial inputs, timesteps, actions, and context
generate_sincos_pos_embed: generate 2D sine-cosine positional embeddings using get_2d_sincos_pos_embed function
